member.summary: Public, stable names for every telemetry point GitHubCrawler emits. The library emits only through the base class library ( and ) and takes no exporter or SDK dependency. Emission is effectively free until a host subscribes to and . These names are a public contract consumed by dashboards and alerts. Do not rename them casually. member.name: M:GitHubCrawler.GitHubRepoCrawler.GetFileContentsAsync(System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Asynchronously downloads file contents from a GitHub URL. The response is fully buffered into and the underlying HTTP response is disposed before returning. A response with a status code of 400 or above is returned to the caller (it is not thrown), and is recorded in telemetry as a failure with error.type set to the status code. Emits the "githubcrawler get_file_contents" span with a "github file.download" child, and the githubcrawler.operation.*, githubcrawler.github.*, and githubcrawler.file.download.size metrics.
member.param: A cancellation token that can be used to cancel the operation.
member.returns: A GitHubFileResponse containing the file content and metadata. Never null.
member.exception: Thrown when this method is called after the object has been disposed.
Thrown when the URL is null or empty.
Thrown when the URL is not an absolute URL.
Thrown when the request fails at the network level.
Thrown when the operation is cancelled or times out.
